newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Median house price stable in NZ, eases in Auckland.
newsitem.headline: Median house price stable in NZ, eases in Auckland.

text.p: New Zealand house sales rose to 6,463 in August from 5,508 in July, with the median price remaining unchanged at NZ$147,000, the Real Estate Institute of New Zealand said on Thursday.
President Colin Brown said the improved sales were partly seasonal.

"In addition, interest rates do not appear to be having any significant depressant effect on the market, largely because of the very strong competition between mortgage lenders for the lucrative housing market," he said.
Some buyers were taking a "wait and see" attitude until the October 12 general election.
The median house price for the Auckland region (Wellsford to Coromandel) eased to $220,000 from $222,500 in July, but sales improved to 2,032 from 1,793 in July.
The August 1995 median price was $187,000 in Auckland and 139,000 nationwide.
